text: Bijli girne se hamare khet me do kisan mar gaye. Sisai block me koi storm shelter nahi hai.
Lightning struck an open paddy field killing 2 workers. Need a siren warning relay.
Ganga nadi ka paani badh raha hai. Diwani ghat ke 3 gaon doob chuke hain. 200 parivaar phas gaye hain.
Jharia coal mines underground fire reached near main market houses. Ground cracking rapidly.
Haathi ka jhund gaon me ghus gaya aur khet aur kachhe ghar tod diye. Log jungle ke kinare dare hue hain.
Severe thunderstorm destroyed transmission poles and blocked the main bypass road.
Bokaro thermal plant area toxic gas leak odor making school students dizzy and sick.
Forest fire spreading rapidly across Dalma mountain reserve toward nearby residential hamlets.
Flash flood submerged the low bridge connecting Karra to district hospital.
Unregulated quarry blast shattered roof tiles of 15 village huts causing panicky evacuation.
Handpump has been broken for three weeks. Women walk three kilometres to dry riverbed for muddy water.
Gaon ka ekmatra chaapakal 1 mahine se kharab hai. Peene ke paani ka bhishan sankat hai.
Arsenic contamination detected in municipal borewell water. Yellow residue and stomach infections.
Primary health centre water supply pipeline punctured. No clean water for delivery room.
Check dam sluice gate broken, entire monsoon runoff drained away leaving reservoir dry.
Kuan me kachra girne se paani sad gaya hai. 50 ghara roz nikalta tha ab band hai.
Fluoride levels in drinking water causing joint deformation among school youth.
Water tanker has not visited this hilltop tribal tola for ten days in scorching heat.
Borewell motor burnt after power surge. High school without drinking water facility.
Drainage backflow contaminating groundwater near community tap stand.
Snakebite cases rising during harvest but sub-centre has zero anti-venom vials. One victim died.
Kala-azar fever spreading across tribal hamlet with no testing kits available.
Dialysis patient cut off because ambulance cannot cross mudlogged link road.
Severe malnutrition observed in 20 children after anganwadi supply delivery stopped.
Maternity sub-centre solar refrigerator battery failed, vaccines spoiled.
Oxygen concentrator at rural health outpost malfunctioning during respiratory season.
Diarrhea outbreak after pond overflowed into surrounding domestic wells.
Culvert collapsed during torrential rain cutting off three panchayats from market town.
Pulliya toot gayi hai, gaadi aur ambulance nahi aa pa rahi hai bilkul.
Paved road washed away leaving a 10-foot deep trench across the school route.
Wooden suspension footbridge over river has decayed planks, children risk falling.
Landslide debris blocking ghat road between Patratu and valley settlements.
Submerged causeway prevents milk and crop produce vans from reaching railway siding.
Village access path severely eroded by river bank cutting during high flow.
Paddy crops drying up completely due to 45-day rain deficit. Need emergency diesel pumps.
Brown plant hopper pest attack destroying 200 acres of paddy fields in block.
Lift irrigation canal silted and blocked with mud, tail-end farmers getting no water.
Cold wave destroyed vegetable potato seedlings across 50 smallholder tribal farms.
Cattle disease foot-and-mouth outbreak reported, no veterinary medicines available in panchayat.
Grain warehouse roof leaking, stored harvested paddy rotting under moisture.
Government primary school asbestos roof blown away by storm. Classes running under tree.
Middle school compound flooded with knee-deep stagnant water breeding mosquitoes.
School boundary wall collapsed next to deep mining pit, extreme hazard for small children.
Solar panel inverter stolen from digital literacy lab, all educational computers dead.
Girls toilet in secondary school without running water or doors causing high dropout.
100 kVA distribution transformer burnt 20 days ago. Whole village in total blackout.
Cellular tower generator battery dead, zero mobile network coverage for 15 km radius.
High voltage transmission cable sagging within 5 feet of ground over village path.
Primary health clinic generator has no fuel, dark during emergency night deliveries.
Gram panchayat optical fiber line severed during ditch digging, internet disconnected.
